description: Memorandum of Understanding  to be entered into between Sri Lanka and Bahrain  on Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic, Special and Official  Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to enter into Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Bahrain on Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic, Special and Official Passports, was approved by the Cabinet.
